metadata.source: S. Y. Lee, T. Y. Jeong, S. Jung, K. J. Yee. Refractive index dispersion of hexagonal boron nitride in the visible and near-infrared. Phys. Status Solidi B, 256, 1800417 (2018) (https://doi.org/10.1002/pssb.201800417); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description: Hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN). In-plane refractive index (ordinary ray, no). h-BN flakes of thickness around 1000 nm were mechanically exfoliated from a bulk crystal and transferred onto quartz substrates for transmission measurements. The single oscillator model is used to fit transmission spectra of several hBN flakes of different thickness.
